name: Amazon PHX6 Fulfillment Center, Phoenix AZ

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in Dec-2025 Street View (pano QYC0WAXQoSn6fA1-CtfvnA): a long white cantilever/sliding gate spans the truck (equipment) entrance off the west drive, set in a masonry perimeter screen wall, with red NO TRESPASSING / EQUIPMENT ENTRANCE signage and an Amazon site placard. Controlled truck gate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the truck gate in any Street View heading (N/NE/ENE/E). The structure adjacent to the gate is the building's glass lobby/office entrance, not a 1-3-space guard booth. Classified false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no manned booth -> remote check-in (signage + sliding gate, Amazon Carrier Central appointment system). True; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court inside the gate between the dock face and the south fence holds a deep drop-trailer row plus circulation, ample queue space before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck court is very deep and long (>300 m of paved apron); easily holds a 3+ truck queue inside the gate. Long.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and multiple drive lanes at the SW entry give clear room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank runs the full ~370 m south face of the building with trailers backed in across z19-z20 imagery; well over 50 doors. Exact count ~120 estimated, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Second full-length row of drop trailers parked nose-out in the truck court in addition to the docked row; 50+ band. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Drop capacity is the single long court row (~no separate multi-acre trailer lot on-parcel); estimated ~200, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; truck-only site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense southwest-Phoenix industrial fabric inside the metro, adjacent to I-10; Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~93.7 ac developed footprint (building + north employee parking + south truck court) from the traced perimeter; the ~1.2M sq ft building dominates.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single very large (~1.2M sq ft) FC building; the warehouses north and south across the public roads are separate parcels/tenants, excluded.
